HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Careers in Home Management 3.0 Cl and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Child Health Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

2. C — newton (N)

3. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

12. A — 100 °C

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ventilation and Lighting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Careers in Home Management 3.0 Cl; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Maternal Health care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Child Health Care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
